purpose: Document city-specific first-party registry evidence, service-access limits and bounded public parcel-geometry route review.
assessment: The official Donetsk Oblast StateGeoCadastre maintains a dedicated cadastral and registration service section. Its current wartime notice describes suspension of user access to the state cadastre for listed combat or occupied administrative units; its 2026 notice describes a narrow new registration workflow for certain residential land plots in occupied/hostilities territories. This confirms registry administration, not an operating public registry in occupied Donetsk city. The official National Geoportal login page states that access to its public portion has been restricted since 24 February 2022; official e-land services require authorization and warn that registrar-processed requests for active-hostility/temporarily occupied areas are delayed until the access-restriction list changes.
